name: raw_ticks
sql: select t.id, t.book, t.event_id, t.market, t.back_home, t.back_away, t.book_updated_at, t.seen_at, t.event_status from ten287_rec.ticks t where t.event_id = 74753338 order by t.book, t.book_updated_at, t.id

name: raw_polls
sql: select book, max(processed_at) filter (where status_code = 200) last_ok from ten287_rec.requests where kind = 'updated' group by 1

name: rpc_event
sql: select e from jsonb_array_elements(public.chart_book_series(now() - interval '4 days', now() + interval '10 days')->'events') e where e->>'event_id' = '74753338'

name: rpc_meta
sql: with r as (select public.chart_book_series(now() - interval '4 days', now() + interval '10 days') j) select j->'books' books, j->'polled_ok_at' polled, j->'kibl_sweep_ok_at' kibl from r

name: b105_raw_obs
sql: select o.fixture_id, o.side_id, o.fixture_participant_id, o.price_decimal, o.inserted_on, o.is_live from public.kibl_line_observations o where o.fixture_id in (select ocs.fixture_id::bigint from public.odds_card_state ocs where ocs.match_key='2026-09-26|damm|hurkacz' and ocs.book='bet105' and ocs.is_selected) and o.feed_source_id=171 and o.market_type_id=1 and o.segment_id=1 and o.betting_type_id=1 order by o.inserted_on

name: b105_fixture
sql: select kf.* from public.kibl_fixtures kf where kf.fixture_id in (select ocs.fixture_id::bigint from public.odds_card_state ocs where ocs.match_key='2026-09-26|damm|hurkacz' and ocs.book='bet105')
